title: TCG: Paldean Fates
description: Shiny Pokémon take center stage in this special set!

questions.question: What is the main theme of Paldean Fates?
questions.explanation: Paldean Fates focuses on Shiny Pokémon from the Paldea region.

questions.question: Paldean Fates is a special set, similar to Hidden Fates and Shining Fates.
questions.explanation: It continues the 'Fates' tradition of shiny-focused special sets.

questions.question: Which shiny chase card became the most popular pull?
questions.explanation: Shiny Charizard ex was the most coveted chase card from Paldean Fates.

questions.question: Paldean Fates introduced Baby Shiny cards in a smaller print run.
questions.explanation: 'Baby Shinies' are the smaller-art shiny variants with bracket marks around their names.

questions.question: Which shiny Pokémon ex from Paldea appears as a Special Illustration Rare?
questions.explanation: Paldean Fates includes shiny SIR versions of several Paradox and Paldean ex Pokémon.

questions.question: How many cards are in the Paldean Fates set?
questions.explanation: Paldean Fates has 245 cards including its Shiny subset and secret rares.

questions.question: The Paldean Fates ETB came with a Great Tusk ex promo.
questions.explanation: The Elite Trainer Box was bundled with a Great Tusk ex promo card.

questions.question: Which Paradox Pokémon got a shiny ex card in Paldean Fates?
questions.explanation: Shiny Iron Hands ex is one of the chase shiny ex pulls.

questions.question: Paldean Fates products were notoriously hard to find at launch.
questions.explanation: Like Pokémon 151, Paldean Fates was plagued by shortages and scalping at launch.
